name: Tall Annual Willowherb
desc: Tall Annual Willowherb (Epilobium brachycarpum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Epilobium brachycarpum is a species of willowherb known by the common names tall willowherb, tall annual willowherb, panicled willowherb and tall fireweed.
